# Stockfish.js 10.0.2

This directory vendors the unmodified JavaScript build of `stockfish.js` 10.0.2. It is loaded on demand by the reader core's chess Worker.

- Upstream: https://github.com/niklasf/stockfish.js
- Exact npm source commit: https://github.com/niklasf/stockfish.js/tree/e105072e84cf8ee5dd5219e2c5be29c3b8bf8a5a
- Source archive: https://github.com/niklasf/stockfish.js/archive/e105072e84cf8ee5dd5219e2c5be29c3b8bf8a5a.tar.gz
- Version metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/stockfish.js/10.0.2
- Distributed archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/stockfish.js/-/stockfish.js-10.0.2.tgz
- Previous runtime source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/stockfish.js/10.0.2/stockfish.js
- License: GNU GPL version 3; full text in COPYING.txt. Copyright notices in stockfish.js are preserved. See README.upstream.md for contributors and upstream build information.

The npm package and previous CDN JavaScript file were compared byte for byte and are identical (1,579,948 bytes). The optional WebAssembly build is not used. No engine code has been modified. ASTRAEA-JP loads only this fixed JavaScript file, with no model or paid service calls.
